items.statement: All preparations offered or intended for ophthalmic use, including preparations for cleansing the eyes, should be sterile.
items.quote: Informed medical opinion is in agreement that all preparations offered or intended for ophthalmic use, including preparations for cleansing the eyes, should be sterile.
items.condition: preparations for ophthalmic use

items.statement: Containers of ophthalmic preparations are sterile at the time of filling and closing.
items.quote: The containers of ophthalmic preparations shall be sterile at the time of filling and closing
items.condition: ophthalmic preparations

items.statement: The container or individual carton of ophthalmic preparations is sealed so that the contents cannot be used without destroying the seal.
items.quote: the container or individual carton shall be so sealed that the contents cannot be used without destroying the seal
items.condition: ophthalmic preparations

items.statement: Packaging and labeling of over-the-counter ophthalmic preparations also comply with the FDA tamper-resistant packaging requirements for over-the-counter drug products.
items.quote: The packaging and labeling of ophthalmic preparations that are over-the-counter drugs shall also comply with § 211.132 of this chapter on tamper-resistant packaging requirements.
items.condition: ophthalmic preparations that are over-the-counter drugs

items.statement: Liquid ophthalmic preparations packed in multiple-dose containers should contain one or more suitable and harmless substances that inhibit the growth of microorganisms, or alternatively be packaged and labeled as described in the next item.
items.quote: Contain one or more suitable and harmless substances that will inhibit the growth of microorganisms; or
items.condition: liquid ophthalmic preparations in multiple-dose containers

items.statement: Liquid ophthalmic preparations packed in multiple-dose containers should, as the alternative to containing a suitable antimicrobial substance, be packaged as to container volume and type and labeled as to duration of use and with necessary warnings so as to give adequate protection and minimize the hazard of injury from contamination during use.
items.quote: Be so packaged as to volume and type of container and so labeled as to duration of use and with such necessary warnings as to afford adequate protection and minimize the hazard of injury resulting from contamination during use.
items.condition: liquid ophthalmic preparations in multiple-dose containers

items.statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other dispensers intended for ophthalmic use should be sterile.
items.quote: Eye cups, eye droppers, and other dispensers intended for ophthalmic use should be sterile
items.condition: dispensers intended for ophthalmic use

items.statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other ophthalmic dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with should be packaged so that sterility is maintained until the package is opened.
items.quote: should be packaged so as to maintain sterility until the package is opened
items.condition: dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with

items.statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other ophthalmic dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with should be labeled, on or within the retail package, with adequate directions and necessary warnings to minimize the hazard of injury from contamination during use.
items.quote: be labeled, on or within the retail package, so as to afford adequate directions and necessary warnings to minimize the hazard of injury resulting from contamination during use
items.condition: dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with
